يستهلكون (form X)
# يَسْتَهْلِكُونَ (yastahlikūna) /jas.tah.li.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# يُسْتَهْلَكُونَ (yustahlakūna) /jus.tah.la.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
